With a minimalistic blueprint for you to create your own space, The Lakeview Room consists of sleek, contemporary chandeliers, a dance floor, stage and an adjacent outdoor patio, all with convenient parking. It can be rented as an entire suite, accommodating up to 250 guests, or divided into separate rooms for smaller groups.
